# Introduction

To analyze human thymic development atlas with ISC

https://cellxgene.cziscience.com/collections/de13e3e2-23b6-40ed-a413-e9e12d7d3910/private

This dataset is used in https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.02.28.708722v1 to explore differences between assays


# 0. Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, 
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)
```

```{r libraries}
# Load packages
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(BiocParallel)
library(Seurat)
library(scTypeEval)
library(tibble)
source("helpers/consistency_exploration.R")
source("helpers/inter_assay.R")
source("helpers/utils.R")
# Custom theme
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 12))
```

Define which ISC paramters
```{r set_ISC}
#black list from scTypeEval package
data(black_list)
bl <- list(black_list$TCR, black_list$Immunoglobulins, black_list$Ygenes) %>% unlist()
# define used ISC
mety <- c("local" = "silhouette | recip_classif:Match",
          "global" = "2label_silhouette | Pseudobulk:Cosine")

# mety <- c("local" = "silhouette | recip_classif:Match",
#           "global" = "NeighborhoodPurity | Pseudobulk:Cosine")
# Define dissimilarities to use
dm <- c("Pseudobulk:Cosine",
        "recip_classif:Match")
# min samples to consider a cell type
min_samples <- 3
min_cells <- 10
```

## Reverse log norm
counts seem to be log1p normalized, let's revert it

```{r}
check_counts(object$counts)
```

```{r}
counts_raw_path <- "~/Documents/Projects/ISC_benchmark_reproducibility/data/thymus_develop_Park/027cb841-f726-45e9-8cea-ac5484c24474_rawcounts.rds"
if(!exists(counts_raw_path)) {
  mat <- reverseNormalize_matrix(mat = object$counts) 
  saveRDS(mat, counts_raw_path)
} else {
  mat <- readRDS(counts_raw_path)
} 
object$counts <- mat
rm(mat);gc()
```

```{r}
check_counts(object$counts)
apply(object$counts[,1:10], 2, sum)
```



# 2. Run scTypeEval

## 2.1 Processing

```{r}
md <- object$metadata
counts <- object$counts[,rownames(md)]
#create sceval object
sc <- create_scTypeEval(matrix = counts,
                        metadata = md,
                        black_list = bl)

sc <- run_processing_data(sc,
                          ident = ident,
                          sample = sample,
                          # enforce more cell type by lower threshold of samples
                          min_samples = min_samples,
                          min_cells = min_cells,
                          verbose = F)

sc <- run_hvg(sc, 
              aggregation = "single-cell",
              ngenes = 2000,
              var_method = "scran",
              ncores = 5, 
              verbose = F)

# no need to run pca on single-cell data
single_mat <- sc@data$`single-cell`
sc@data$`single-cell` <- NULL

sc <- run_pca(sc,
              scale. = F,
              verbose = F)

for(mdiss in dm){
  cat("#### Running ", mdiss, " ####\n")
  sc <- run_dissimilarity(sc,
                          method = mdiss,
                          ncores = 7,
                          verbose = F)
}
# return single-cell data for SCCAF and MetaNeighbor
sc@data$`single-cell` <- single_mat
rm(single_mat); gc()
```

# 3. Consistency

```{r}
cons0 <- get_consistency(sc,
                         consistency_metric = c("silhouette",
                                                "2label_silhouette",
                                                "NeighborhoodPurity")
)

cons <- 
  cons0 %>% 
  mutate(method.type = paste(consistency_metric,
                             dissimilarity_method,
                             sep = " | ")) %>% 
  filter(method.type %in% mety) %>% 
  mutate(method.type = factor(method.type,
                              levels = mety,
                              labels = names(mety))) %>% 
  select(method.type, measure, celltype) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "method.type",
              values_from = "measure") %>% 
  mutate(measure = global * local
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(measure))

consis <- cons %>%
  arrange(measure)
```

## 3.1. plotting
### barplot
```{r}
q_local <- 0.45
q_global <- 0.74
consistency_barplot(consis, x_threshold = q_local)
consistency_barplot(consis, xval = "global",
                    x_threshold = q_global, xlabel = "global")
```

### scatter

Joint distribution of per-cell-type ISCL (silhouette on reciprocal-classification match) and ISCG (2-label silhouette on pseudobulk cosine similarity) across atlas labels (“cell_type”). Each point represents one annotated cell type. 

```{r}
consistency_scatter(consis)
```

# 8. Compare inter-assay

```{r}
comb <- get_method_sample_combinations(object$metadata)

# hardcode other combinations

spl_grid <- expand.grid(
  group1 = c("3GEX.A", "3GEX.B"),
  group2 = c("5GEX.A", "5GEX.B"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
spl_comb <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(spl_grid)), function(i) {
  g1 <- spl_grid$group1[i]
  g2 <- spl_grid$group2[i]
   
  v <- c(comb[[g1]], comb[[g2]])
  return(v)
}) 
names(spl_comb) <- paste(spl_grid$group1, spl_grid$group2, sep = "_")

combi <- c(comb, spl_comb)
```

```{r inter-assay, message=T, warning = F}
#assay_isc <- list()

for(i in names(combi)){
  if(i %in% names(assay_isc)){next}
  
  cat(">>> Doing ", i, " <<<\n")
    
  assay_isc[[i]] <- run_isc(counts = object$counts,
                            metadata = object$metadata,
                            which_samples = combi[[i]],
                            black_list = bl,
                            hvg = sc@gene_lists$HVG)
}
```

### Join allin a dataframe

```{r}
cons_df <- lapply(names(assay_isc), function(n){
  ss <- combi[[n]]
  ns_5 <- table(factor(grepl("5GEX", ss), levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)))
  rat <- paste0(ns_5[[1]], "/", ns_5[[2]])
  
  df <- assay_isc[[n]]$consistency %>% 
    mutate(combination = n,
           ratio_35 = rat,
           method_type = paste(consistency_metric, dissimilarity_method, sep = " | "))
  return(df)
}) %>%  
  data.table::rbindlist() %>% 
  filter(!method_type %in% c("2label_silhouette | recip_classif:Match",
                             "silhouette | Pseudobulk:Cosine")) %>% 
  mutate(combination = factor(combination,
                              levels = names(combi)))
```


### plot ISC
```{r}
cons_pl <- cons_df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(combination, measure)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = F,
               outlier.colour = NA,
               alphal = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(color = celltype),
             show.legend = F,
             alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(group = celltype,
                color = celltype),
            show.legend = F,
            alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(x = "Number of 3GEX / 5GEX samples") +
  facet_wrap(~method_type,
             scales = "free_y") +
  ggpubr::theme_classic2() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1))

cons_pl
```
